headline: New Zealand Poll Points to Hung Parliament Ahead of Vote
summary: New Zealand's latest poll pointed to a hung parliament, with each major bloc holding 60 seats ahead of the upcoming weekend election.
why: Political uncertainty surrounding hung parliaments can delay fiscal policy implementation and affect national currency and bond market stability.

impacts.name: New Zealand
impacts.why: Polling indicating a hung parliament introduces potential legislative deadlock.
